items.title: Don Albert and Herbert Hall Interview, 1978-08-03
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...he was working for the Pells... [INTERVIEWEE] And now there's no more Pells.

ctx.x: Don't look back America. Something might be getting him. It's really a shame that he never got that break, did he? Right. Of course, he was working for the Pells, but I never saw him when I went to games. I mean, last year, whenever it was. That's only one season the Pells had recently.
And now there's no more Pells. They can't bring him back.
I don't think New Orleans was a sports town that it once was.
